newsitem.title: USA: Lunn Industries says in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Lunn Industries says in merger talks.

text.p: Lunn Industries Inc said it has been in discussions with privately held Technical Products Group Inc about a possible stock-for-stock merger.
Lunn said the two companies have agreed in principle to an arrangement in which Lunn shareholders would retain about 26 percent of the combined entity on a fully diluted basis.

The merger contemplates an exchange of one share of the combined corporation's common stock for every 10 outstanding shares of Lunn common stock and about 8.3 shares for every share of Technical Product's common stock, it said.

There are currently about 14.6 million shares of Lunn common stock outstanding on a fully diluted basis and about 500,000 shares of Technical Products common stock outstanding on a fully diluted basis.

Technical Products is primarily a manufacturer of advanced composite structures produced for the aerospace and defense industries and had sales of about $125 million for the year ended December 31, 1996.

Lunn and its wholly owned subsidiary, Alcore Inc, manufacture composite structures, bonded assemblies and aluminum honeycomb for aerospace, transportation, construction, electronics and defense industries.
The merger is subject to the execution of a definitive agreement, certain regulatory approvals as well as stockholder approvals, and certain other conditions, Lunn said.
